scope: Map receiver of World chat, including existing event announcements. Player-chat routing in World remains incomplete.

history_review.finding: MW_CHAT_REQ has been an empty handler since the first .NET port.
Preserve client chat bans and sender spoof rejection.

rules: Show/map/world deliveries broadcast to main in-game sessions; native channel/target context does not narrow recipients locally.
Party/guild/force/tactics/whisper delivery requires a current character key and main in-game route. Sender echo uses group; recipients use display type.
Peace recipient, peace sender and neutral sender bypass faction checks; social groups allow different factions; other supported groups compare effective aid/base country.
All deliveries use the existing protected-list helper. No client-port injection. Existing Latin1 wire encoding is unchanged.
remaining: See Gameforge/chat-routing.json for implemented routing and current remaining verification.
snapshot_stage: Historical receiver-only validation before the World routing follow-up.

current_deployment.note: Earlier implementation/validation notes retain their historical scope. Current cumulative source is deployed; deployment does not certify whole-game or full gameplay restart parity.
